description: Create a draft purchase order for a supplier. The order is always a draft: an agent cannot create an approved or sent order. Approval is requested with rr_request_purchase_order_approval, and an order must be approved before it can be sent. Given action_id, the new order is linked to that recommendation unless it is already linked to an order that is not cancelled or dismissed. Returns the new order and its items_added count.

action_id.description: Optional recommendation UUID to link to the draft PO.

destination_location_id.description: The id of the location the goods will arrive at.

expected_delivery_date.description: Optional expected delivery date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

items.description: Required line items: [{sku, quantity, unit_cost}, ...]. The server validates quantities, constraints, and trusted cost fallbacks.

quantity.description: Quantity to order for this SKU.

unit_cost.description: Optional unit cost; the server falls back to a trusted cost when omitted.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes to attach to the draft PO.

name: rr_create_purchase_order
